config.message: $(user) has followed, Welcome to the stream!
Hype train has started! It started at $(hypetrain.progress) and will end at $(hypetrain.end)
Hype train has progressed to level $(hypetrain.level)!
Hype train has ended! It ended at level $(hypetrain.level) with $(hypetrain.progress)% progress!
$(ad.time) seconds of ad break has begun!
$(user) subscribed with $(sub.tier) for the first time!
$(user) resubscribed with $(sub.tier) for $(sub.months) months on a row!

description.EN: Thank another streamer when they send your channel a shoutout.
description.ES: Agradece a otro streamer cuando le hace un shoutout a tu canal.

description.EN: Incoming raid protection, announcements, clips and shoutouts. Independent of outgoing tracking.
description.ES: Protección ante raids entrantes, anuncios, clips y shoutouts. Independiente del registro de salida.

description.EN: Track channels you raid for your dashboard. An empty message tracks silently. Disabling or deleting stops outgoing tracking only; recorded history remains.
description.ES: Registra los canales a los que haces raid para tu panel. Un mensaje vacío registra en silencio. Desactivar o eliminar solo detiene el registro de salida; el historial se conserva.

description.EN: Post a message when a subscription expires. Leave the message empty to stay silent.
description.ES: Publica un mensaje cuando vence una suscripción. Deja el mensaje vacío para no anunciarlo.
